svg.aria-label: A helicorder of internet incidents: 24 rows, one per hour, the trace rising when many services had open incidents.
svg.text: Every incident across 813 status pages in the 24 hours to 14:00 UTC, 03 Nov 2026, one row per hour.
Trace height follows the weighted number of open incidents (194 in this window). The fine texture is drawn, not measured. Flags mark major and critical incidents.
